tasks.title: Conversation #26
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Our annual cultural festival is just two months away. Have you had a chance to look at my layout design?
Man: Yeah, looks good. Just one question. Why did you move the location of the vendor booths? They were along the south side of the field last year.
Woman: Remember, we alternate their positioning year to year to give the grass a chance to fully recover. All that concentrated foot traffic does a lot of damage.
Man: Okay, and where are we up to with vendor registration? How many payments have we collected?
Woman: Actually, Javier is handling all the vendor business. He's around here somewhere.

questions.stem: Why have the vendor booths been moved?

options.C: To make it easier to repair the booths
options.D: To keep the booths away from car traffic

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问供应商摊位被移动的原因，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士对摊位位置变化的直接解释。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中提到的是为了保护草地，而非避开烈日，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 女士明确说“we alternate their positioning year to year to give the grass a chance to fully recover. All that concentrated foot traffic does a lot of damage.”，说明移动摊位是为了保护草地，让其有时间恢复。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到修理摊位的问题，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：错误。 对话中未提及车辆交通，女士解释的原因是人员密集走动对草地造成损害，而非车辆。

questions.stem: What does the woman imply when she says, "Javier is handling all the vendor business"?

options.A: Javier does not have time to complete other tasks.
options.B: Javier needs some help collecting payments.
options.C: The man does not need to worry about the vendor business.
options.D: The man should ask Javier for more information.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士说“Javier is handling all the vendor business”时暗示了什么，属于推理判断题，需结合上文男士的问题和女士后半句话理解其言外之意。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中没有提到Javier没有时间完成其他任务，属于无中生有。 选项B：错误。 女士没有暗示Javier需要帮助收取付款，只是说明他在负责此事。 选项C：错误。 女士并没有明确表示男士不需要操心，而是指出负责人在别处，暗示她无法回答，需要男士自己去问。 选项D：正确。 男士询问供应商注册和付款收取情况，女士没有直接回答具体数字，而是说Javier在负责所有供应商事务，并且“He's around here somewhere”，暗示她不知道具体信息，建议男士去找Javier了解详情。
